references.text: Describes how the ephod is to be joined together at the shoulders, using the same construction principle of joining.
Parallel text describing the actual making of the ephod with shoulder pieces that were joined together, as prescribed.
The same Hebrew root (חבר) is used for the joining of the tabernacle curtains, illustrating the principle of joining holy objects.
Uses the same term for joining (חבר) in the construction of the tabernacle curtains.
Complementary detail: The source describes the structure of the shoulder piece, while this verse adds the gold rings attached at the same place.
Fulfillment of the linking instruction: Confirms that the shoulder pieces (from the source verse) were used to attach the chains as God commanded.
Fulfillment of the ring attachment: Confirms that the specific shoulder pieces from the source verse received the required gold rings.
